title: Chat: one call, no documents
sub: Send the question straight to the model, with no retrieval and no tools, and return whatever comes back.

steps.h: Your code sends the question as-is, with no documents attached
steps.d:
SYSTEM  You answer questions about Halvorsen appliances. You
        have not been given any manual. If you do not know a
        fact, say so plainly instead of guessing.
USER    What voltage does a DR-210 need?

steps.h: The model answers from what it already knows
steps.d:
"I don't have documentation on a 'Halvorsen DR-210', so I
can't state its voltage requirement without guessing. Check
the rating label or the installation manual."
